name: TotalEnergies
notes: Revenue = 'Sales' (top line, includes excise taxes). operatingIncome = Total's 'Total operating income' (revenues from sales less purchases, other operating expenses, exploration costs and depreciation, depletion and amortization; before other income and expense, financial items, equity-affiliate income and taxes). Total's income statement shows that line as reported for 2001-2006 (French GAAP 2001-2003, IFRS 2004-2006); from 2007 the line is no longer shown, so 2007-2025 are derived (quality estimated) on exactly that scope from the reported lines. Unlike BP and Shell it leaves out equity-affiliate income, and from IFRS the depreciation line includes impairments. EUR reporting through FY2012 results; USD from FY2014 results onward with 2013 restated in USD (2013 anchor is the USD restatement). 2004 is IFRS pre-Arkema restatement; 2005 restated ex-Arkema. 2015-2017 from the FY2017 20-F, later years from their own 20-F (XBRL R2). FY ends Dec 31.
